astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Thackeray's Globules
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: What are these strange space globs?  Situated in rich star fields and glowing hydrogen gas, these opaque clouds of interstellar dust and gas are so large they might be able to form stars. Their home is known as IC 2944, a bright stellar nursery located about 7,600 light years away toward the constellation of the Centaur (Centaurus).
